camel_example: aliyun aidge TextTranslate --region cn-hangzhou --TargetLanguage ko --SourceTextList '["Hello world"]' --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates text by using the Maas-MT e-commerce translation model, which is trained on over 1 billion high-quality bilingual sentence pairs and continuously optimized for e-commerce terms such as brands, models, materials, and attributes. Supports translation between more than 400 language pairs, including pivot languages, especially between Chinese and English, Chinese and other languages, and English and other languages. Supports language identification for 31 languages in query phrases and 35 languages in general scenarios. Automatically identifies the source language if it is not specified
description_zh: Maas-MT是10亿+ 高质量双语句对训练出的电商领域翻译模型，针对电商领域特有的品牌、型号、材质、属性等术语进行不断优化。支持400多种(含桥接)语向间的互译，尤其是中英互译、中文与多语言的互译，英文与多语言的互译。支持 Query 短语31 种语言和通用场景35 种语言的语向识别，如您不设置源语言可实现自动识别
kebab_example: aliyun aidge text-translate --target-language ko --source-text-list '["Hello world"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: TextTranslate

parameters.help_en: The list of text to be translated. This parameter is required. The total character length cannot exceed 50,000, and the list length cannot exceed 50
parameters.help_zh: 待翻译文本列表，必填。总字符长度不超过50000，List长度不超过50
parameters.name: source_text_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. This parameter is optional. You must create the glossary in the console and provide its ID. If the provided intervention glossary ID is empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，选填。需要在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果提供的干预词表ID为空，则翻译结果将不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The format type of the source text. This parameter is optional. Valid values: text (plain text format) and html (web page format, which retains HTML tags)
parameters.help_zh: 源文本的格式类型，选填。支持text（纯文本格式）和html（网页格式，保留HTML标签）
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en: The business scenario identifier. You can specify only one of the following values. After you specify a value, the translation engine calls the terminology library and style policy of the corresponding industry to output translations that better fit the industry. If you do not specify this parameter or specify an invalid value, the general translation policy is used. Valid values: e-commerce-title (cross-border e-commerce product title translation), e-commerce-description (cross-border e-commerce product description translation), e-commerce-chat (cross-border e-commerce conversation translation), e-commerce-cpv (cross-border e-commerce product CPV attribute translation), novel (novel translation), and game (game translation)
parameters.help_zh: 业务场景标识，仅可传入下方任意一个值，传入后翻译引擎将调用对应行业的术语库与风格策略，输出更贴合行业的译文；未传该字段或者传错的时候会执行通用翻译策略。可选值为下方英文部分 ：  e-commerce-title ，跨境电商商品标题翻译；e-commerce-description ，跨境电商商品详描翻译；e-commerce-chat ，跨境电商会话翻译；e-commerce-cpv ， 跨境电商商品 CPV 属性翻译 ；novel ，小说翻译；game ，游戏翻译
parameters.name: translate_scene

parameters.help_en: This field represents your identity and facilitates communication for various issues. If you are an internal Alibaba organization, specify this parameter based on the actual scenario, such as BU name-product or BU name-chat. If you are an external Alibaba partner, specify the full name of your company. The company name must be the same as the company name you used when registering your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 此字段代表您的身份，便于后续各类问题的沟通  。如果您是阿里内部组织，建议您根据实际场景进行传入，例如BU名称-商品，或者BU名称 -chat等；如果您是阿里外部伙伴，建议您传入公司名称的全称，此公司名称需要和您注册阿里云账号时候的公司名称保持一致
parameters.name: biz_name

Code.description_en: The response code. If the call is successful, "success" is returned
Code.description_zh: 响应代码，正常调用时返回"success"
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The translation result data, which includes the translation list and usage information
Data.description_zh: 翻译结果数据，包含翻译列表和用量信息

Translations.description_en: The list of translation results. Each element corresponds to a translation result for an item in the input text list
Translations.description_zh: 翻译结果列表，每个元素对应输入文本列表中的一条翻译结果

Characters.description_en: The number of characters in the source text

DetectedLanguage.description_en: The automatically detected source language code
DetectedLanguage.description_zh: 自动识别出的源语种代码

UsageMap.description_en: The usage information, which includes the number of input characters
UsageMap.description_zh: 用量信息，包含输入字符数等

Message.description_en: The error message. If the call is successful, "Success" is returned. If an exception occurs, a specific error message is returned, such as "The parameter contains sensitive information. Please try another input."
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"，异常时返回具体错误信息，例如"参数中包含敏感信息，请尝试其他输入"
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to identify a unique request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
Success.title_en: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
